notes.title: Update notes for Jun 2
notes.content: Hey everyone, I'm excited to share some updates about Drone Adventure! The latest version includes some exciting upgrades that I think you're going to love. One of the key additions is the implementation of (x ** 1/3) * 3 to most controls, which has really enhanced the overall experience. Now, you can also customize your in-game settings to control where you'd like your throttle to start – whether it's at the center or at the bottom of the axis. These upgrades have taken the gameplay to a whole new level, providing users with more control and an even more immersive experience. I can't wait for you to try it out and experience the difference for yourself. Stay tuned for more updates and happy flying!

notes.title: May 14th Patch notes
notes.content:
Hey there! Today I want to talk about an exciting new game feature that's got everyone buzzing - the latest update for Drone Adventure! This update promises to take the game to a whole new level with bug fixes, the introduction of more UFOs the deeper you go, and the spawning of better and better crystals underground. But that's not all - players can also expect to see crystals appearing in blimps, adding a whole new dimension to the game. It's safe to say that fans of Drone Adventure have a lot to look forward to with this update. So, get ready to dive in and experience the thrill of uncovering valuable crystals while navigating through an increasingly challenging UFO-filled environment. Happy gaming!
